text: One owner. Zero staff. Picture a café run like this. Here's how she keeps up. At midnight, a chatbot answers the DMs. Opening hours, the oat milk question, whether dogs are allowed. In the morning, online booking has already filled the tables, and reminder texts help cut the no shows. At noon, an AI photo tool turns one phone shot of the new pastry into a clean menu photo. After lunch, every review gets a reply, drafted in her voice and checked before it posts. And on Sunday, a scheduling tool queues the whole week of posts in one sitting. That's episode one. Next episode, the flower shop. Send this to the café owner who does everything alone.
